aboutMe.metaDescription: About Diana Bucelea - Coach and Nutritionist at Amazonia FitLab.
aboutMe.name: Diana Bucelea
aboutMe.p1: I believe a coach has the responsibility to learn continuously. That is why I have invested years of study in nutrition and clinical nutrition, training methodology, and interpreting scientific research, attending national and international courses and certifications.
aboutMe.p2: Every credential you see below represents more than just a qualification. It represents my commitment to offering you evidence-based guidance, rather than opinions or industry trends.
aboutMe.highlight: Credentials are not the end goal. They are proof of my commitment to offering you the very best recommendations that science can support.
aboutMe.p3: My ongoing education enables me to distinguish evidence-backed recommendations from information popularized purely because it is trending. That is why my coaching process starts with a comprehensive analysis of your needs, goals, and lifestyle, rather than a one-size-fits-all plan.
aboutMe.p4: Every strategy is customized, grounded in the best available evidence, and clearly explained so that you understand not just what to do, but why. I emphasize sustainable results, education, and autonomy—because the ultimate goal is not to keep you dependent on a coach, but to empower you with the confidence and knowledge needed to make sound decisions independently over the long term.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with me, the FitLab app, and our evidence-based methodology.
faq.q1: Do I need prior gym experience to start?
faq.a1: Not at all. Every program is calibrated from scratch to match your current experience level, joint mechanics, and training background. Whether you are stepping into a gym for the first time or are an experienced lifter aiming for a breakthrough, your routine is personalized to progress safely and effectively.
faq.q2: Can I train at home, or do I need a fully equipped gym?
faq.a2: You can do either! During our initial get-to-know call, we review your available equipment and schedule. Your plan is tailored specifically for your environment, whether that means a home gym, dumbbells, or a commercial fitness center.
faq.q3: What is the difference between In-Person and Online coaching?
faq.a3: Both coaching modalities share the exact same nutritional guidance, lifestyle habits, and FitLab app progress tracking. The only difference is execution feedback: in-person clients receive live, hands-on feedback and form correction in the gym with me, while online clients record their exercises and receive comprehensive video breakdowns and technical reviews.
faq.q4: Is the FitLab mobile app included with the coaching?
faq.a4: Yes, full access to the FitLab companion app is included for all active coaching clients. You will use it to log workouts, track progressive overload, monitor body circumferences, submit weekly check-in photos, and log holistic health metrics like sleep and stress.
faq.q5: Will I have to follow a strict diet or give up foods I love?
faq.a5: Absolutely not. Extreme, restrictive diets are unsustainable and counter-productive. We use science-backed flexible nutrition and personalized macronutrient targets that integrate into your social life and daily routines, ensuring progress without unnecessary food bans.
faq.a6: Getting started is simple! Send me a direct message on Instagram to introduce yourself, share your current goals, and schedule your initial get-to-know consultation call.
